preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 20 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 1 <= N <= 1000 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == len(B) == N and all(c.islower() for c in A) and all(c.islower() for c in B) for (N, A, B) in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, strings A and B have length N and contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == sum(1 if impossible else (1 + K) for (impossible, K) in results)
postconditions.description: The total number of output lines matches the sum of lines required for each test case (1 line for -1, or 1 line for K plus K lines for operations).

postconditions.expression: all((impossible and line == '-1') or (not impossible and line.isdigit()) for (impossible, line) in zip(impossible_flags, [stdout_lines[i] for i in range(len(stdout_lines)) if i % (1 + (0 if impossible_flags[i] else 1)) == 0]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if impossible, the output line is '-1'; otherwise, the first line is an integer K representing the minimum number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(not impossible and all(len(parts) == Z + 1 and all(parts[j].isdigit() for j in range(1, Z + 1)) and len(set(int(parts[j]) for j in range(1, Z + 1))) == Z and all(0 <= int(parts[j]) < N for j in range(1, Z + 1)) for (impossible, K, parts_list) in zip(impossible_flags, K_values, operation_lines_list)) for impossible_flags, K_values, operation_lines_list in test_case_outputs)
postconditions.description: For each non-impossible test case, each operation line contains an integer Z followed by Z distinct integers in the range [0, N-1].

postconditions.expression: all(not impossible and simulate_operations(A, B, operations) == B for (impossible, A, B, operations) in zip(impossible_flags, A_list, B_list, all_operations_list))
postconditions.description: For each non-impossible test case, applying the sequence of operations to A results in B, where each operation replaces characters at specified indices with the alphabetically smallest character among those indices in the current string.

postconditions.expression: all(not impossible and K == min_operations(A, B) for (impossible, A, B, K) in zip(impossible_flags, A_list, B_list, K_values))
postconditions.description: For each non-impossible test case, K is the minimum number of operations required to convert A to B.

postconditions.expression: all(impossible and not exists_valid_sequence(A, B) for (impossible, A, B) in zip(impossible_flags, A_list, B_list))
postconditions.description: For each impossible test case, no valid sequence of operations exists to convert A to B.
